jobs.title: Physician (Per Diem, 1099), Blueberry Pediatrics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Blueberry's Mission:

Our mission is to turn every family’s living room into their own personal pediatric urgent care. We combine home exam kits, concierge-like access, and AI-enabled Pediatricians to provide affordable and near-instant clinic-level care, 24/7. We believe every child deserves access to top-quality healthcare.

We’ve proven that by drastically improving access and turning healthcare into a consumer-grade experience, we drive better health outcomes for children and families while dramatically reducing medical costs for parents and health plans (up to 50% reduction in ED costs).

We are a mission and values driven company. You can learn more about our values HERE. 🫐 💙

Note: Beware of Scammers. Blueberry will NEVER ask you to download software/apps or request sensitive personal information like bank accounts or social security numbers. If you received an email requesting this information it is likely a scam. We are only accepting candidates through our job board.

BEFORE READING THROUGH THE JOB DESCRIPTION, PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT CURRENTLY HIRING ADDITIONAL PHYSICIANS. IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN JOINING BLUEBERRY PEDIATRICS, PLEASE PROCEED WITH SUBMITTING AN APPLICATION AND WE WILL FOLLOW UP WITH YOU WHEN WE BEGIN HIRING AGAIN (IF YOUR BACKGROUND AND LICENSES MATCH OUR NEEDS AT THAT TIME). THANK YOU!!

The Opportunity:

Blueberry is on a mission to make high quality pediatric care available to everyone. In this role, you will join a wonderful community of physicians who are fueled by that mission. Beyond that, you’ll have the opportunity to do what you do best REMOTELY!. Our physicians love being a part of Blueberry for three key reasons:

  1. They get to practice high-quality, evidence based medicine.

  2. Their voices matter and our Chief Medical Officer is a pediatrician who represents the voices of the doctors at the executive level.

  3. They may be home alone, but they never feel alone. We are a community of doctors who help each other out!

Who You Are:

  • You are responsible and self-motivated. We do not micromanage. 

  • You uphold Blueberry’s values. You are committed to making sure that every parent has a great experience.

  • You are empathetic. You do a great job of making parents feel heard and understood.

  • You are a person of integrity. We do not prescribe just to satisfy parents. We practice evidence based medicine. We expect all Blueberry doctors to uphold that bar.

  • You are a collaborative partner to our other doctors and our customer support team, with whom you will work to ensure holistic patient care.

Role Details/Requirements:

  • This is a 1099 contract role.

  • You are expected to fulfill a minimum 10-12 hours of on-call time per week*, primarily during high volume hours (4p - 1a EST) and on weekends. Shifts are 3 hours long.

  • In addition to shift hours, we ask that you pick up overflow visits when not on call (you will be compensated $25 per overflow visit you take while not on call). This is a great way to make quick money!

  • It is expected that you accomplish at least 4 or more visits per hour. You will be compensated at a higher hourly rate if you are able to do more than that (ask us for more info).

  • You are an experienced multitasker and are well versed in managing an EMR.

  • You have no conflict of interest with your current job at a competing pediatric telehealth company.

Okay so….Why Work At Blueberry?

Need more convincing? Trust us, we know what the clinical world is like. That’s why we want to make sure that our doctors experience benefits that most clinics would never offer. Such as:

  • Contribute to a mission-driven health-tech company that is out to improve the child healthcare experience!

  • Amazing camaraderie amongst the team as we function as a medical group.

  • Malpractice insurance provided.

  • Stipend for remote office equipment.

  • Quarterly bonuses based on hours worked, quality of care, and feedback.

*Blueberry may not be able to guarantee the minimum 10-12 hours per week every month (example, lower volume months)

Expected wage for this role: $85-100++/hr (calculated by on-call hours + visits completed - ask for more info and we'd be happy to share how compensation is broken out!)

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Opportunity:

At Blueberry, our doctors and patients are at the center of everything we do. We’re looking for a Customer Support Representative who can deliver a reliable, high-quality experience across phone, email, and chat while working in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Who You Are:

  • You are a team player. You acknowledge that we win as a team and are willing to step in and help, even if it’s inconvenient!

  • You are an optimist. You demonstrate a positive attitude and see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow

  • You are flexible and are willing to adapt to adjustments to shift schedules

  • You are organized in the way you manage your workload in order to deliver meaningful results

  • You are willing to work nights and weekends

  • You are a strong communicator both verbally and in writing

  • You are a self-starter. You understand that working remotely is a privilege and you are committed to making high contributions to the team

  • You are coachable. You are open to being coached by all members of the team, not just leadership

What You’ll Own:

  • Support patients and doctors across phone, email, and chat channels

  • Resolve questions efficiently while ensuring a clear, professional experience

  • Follow established workflows and processes to ensure consistency and accuracy

  • Document interactions clearly to support follow-up, collaboration, and continuity of care

  • Use sound judgment to resolve issues independently and escalate when appropriate

  • Maintain strong awareness of SLAs and prioritize work accordingly

Experience You’ll Need:

  • Prior customer support experience (phone, email, or chat)

  • Experience working in remote or structured support environments is a plus

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to stay organized and manage multiple conversations at once

  • Consistent reliability, including punctuality and ownership of scheduled shifts

  • Attention to detail in documentation and task execution

  • Comfort working in a structured environment with defined processes

  • Adaptability in a fast-changing environment

Why join Blueberry?

  • 100% remote role

  • Structured scheduling with consistent evening and weekend coverage (including alternating weekends)

  • Mission-driven company focused on improving healthcare access

*Expected hourly wage: $21 - 23 / hr depending on experience & location

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our practitioners love being a part of Blueberry for three key reasons:

  1. They get to practice high-quality, evidence based medicine

  2. Their voices matter and shape the future of pediatric telehealth

  3. They may be home alone, but they never feel alone. We are a community of clinicians who help each other out!

Who You Are:

  • A board certification Pediatric Nurse Practitioner (PNP) or Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) with significant pediatric clinical experience, with an active license in at least (1) state

  • You are responsible and self-motivated. We do not micromanage.

  • You uphold Blueberry’s values. You are committed to making sure that every parent has a great experience and every child gets great care.

  • You are empathetic. You do a great job of making parents feel heard and understood.

  • You are a person of integrity. We do not prescribe just to satisfy parents.. We practice evidence based medicine. We expect all Blueberry clinicians to uphold that bar.

  • You are a collaborative partner to other medical staff and our customer support team, with whom you will work to ensure holistic patient care

Role Details, Schedule & Shift Expectations***:

  • 1099 Contract

  • You will work 70-80 hours per month

    • Shifts are typically 4-8 hour blocks of time

    • 20% of time expected to be on weekends

  • You are expected to work all shift times evenly

    • Evening and weekend shifts split fairly among group

    • Expanded shift times and overnight hours may be needed in the future

  • You are eligible to earn extra income via contributing during surge times, marketing efforts, and other opportunities

***As a young company, growth requires change. Flexibility will be needed.

Holidays:

  • Major holidays - Must work 1 of 3 major holidays (rotating basis)

    • Thanksgiving

    • Christmas Eve

    • Christmas Day

  • Minor holidays - Required hours split over 2-3 holidays

    • Martin Luther King Day: Jan 15

    • Presidents Day Weekend: Feb 19

    • Easter Weekend: March 31, April 1

    • Memorial Day Weekend: May 27

    • July 4th Weekend: July 4

    • Labor Day Weekend: September 2

    • New Years Weekend: December 31, Jan 1

    • Juneteenth

Okay so….Why Work At Blueberry?

Need more convincing? Trust us, we know what the clinical world is like. That’s why we want to make sure that our medical team experiences benefits that most clinics would never offer. Such as:

  • Market competitive compensation

  • Stipend for remote office supplies

  • All initial licensure paid by company and partial renewal reimbursement

    • Will need ~5 licenses on average to start, increasing to about 15, with some NPs receiving up to 30 in future

    • Concierge service provided to obtain licenses & renewals

  • Minimum 3 year commitment from date of last license issuance, or you will be required to pay back full license costs

If this sounds enticing to you, send in an application and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

*Base compensation rate for this role will be between USD $50-$65/hr depending on location and experience

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Note: Beware of Scammers. Blueberry will NEVER ask you to download software/apps or request sensitive personal information like bank accounts or social security numbers. If you received an email requesting this information it is likely a scam. We are only accepting candidates through our job board.

The Opportunity:

The Client Success Manager is Blueberry's single point of contact and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of clients (health plans and employers). The CSM owns the post-sale relationship end to end (driving member activation, engagement, retention, measurable outcomes, and add on sales) while operating as a managing consulting partner who holds both Blueberry's internal teams and the client accountable to a shared improvement plan.

The role is strategic and commercial: satisfied, activated clients expand into new populations and states, and the CSM is the person who makes that growth happen, sometimes selling alongside the sales (hunter) team and sometimes selling themselves.

What you’ll own:

  • Be the single point of contact. Understand your clients business, their business objectives, what has been sold along with the expected outcomes and ensure we collectively exceed those expectations.

  • Know everything happening in your accounts without being a gatekeeper. Anyone at Blueberry engaging your client loops you in before and after; you keep a complete picture of the relationship.

  • Drive activation and engagement. Grow the active, enrolled member base within existing accounts — the largest and most controllable growth lever in a per-member model.

  • Reduce churn and protect retention. Keep clients healthy, renewing, and expanding.

  • Drive outcomes. Deliver and socialize the clinical and member outcomes (e.g., avoidable-ED reduction) that prove Blueberry's value and justify expansion.

  • Operationalize a consistent client experience: QBRs, annual satisfaction survey, mutually-agreed improvement plans, and executive-sponsor alignment.

  • Hold everyone accountable. Hold Blueberry's implementation, product, and support teams accountable to resolve client issues; hold the client team accountable to their rollout commitments.

  • Grow the account commercially. Expand into new populations and states and become a trusted advisor to the client's key stakeholders. Tee up and partner with the hunter/sales team on net-new expansion; be in the room for commercial conversations whenever it makes sense.

  • Manage scope. Triage across the strategic (a CEO's outcome goals for next year) and the tactical (an unresolved implementation issue) in the same day, and know when to escalate.

  • Act as the operational project manager for your accounts. Maintain high-level visibility and fluency in the day-to-day operations of your portfolio — including implementation status, claims submission, and invoicing accuracy — ensuring you can proactively speak to these workstreams and identify friction points before they impact the client relationship.

What Success Looks Like:

Performance is data-driven and tied to the metrics you own, expected to center on:

  • Activation / active user base and retention (churn)

  • Account growth — new populations and states

  • Improvement over baseline client NPS / satisfaction

  • Implementation velocity: days from contract signing to launch

  • Potentially member/clinical outcomes (e.g., ED)

The role carries a competitive base plus a metrics-driven performance bonus and equity participation.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in client success, account management, or strategic consulting, ideally owning a portfolio of enterprise or health-plan relationships with direct accountability for retention and expansion.

  • A demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts — increasing activation and engagement, protecting retention, and expanding into new populations, products, or geographies.

  • Experience selling, or carrying a number alongside a sales team. You should be comfortable leading commercial conversations and closing expansion, not just managing the relationship.

  • Healthcare experience, especially payer, Medicaid managed-care, or value-based / member-engagement models, with enough fluency to speak credibly to clinical outcomes and per-member economics (a strong plus).

  • Operating experience in an early-stage or high-growth environment — building process where none exists, balancing strategic and tactical work in the same day, and holding cross-functional teams accountable.

Expected compensation for this role: Base salary between $100,000 - $140,000 depending on location and experience + a performance bonus tied to the success metrics outlined above. The role will also include equity.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Blueberry's Mission:

Our mission is to turn every family’s living room into their own personal pediatric urgent care. We combine home exam kits, concierge-like access, and AI-enabled Pediatricians to provide affordable and near-instant clinic-level care, 24/7. We believe every child deserves access to top-quality healthcare.

We’ve proven that by drastically improving access and turning healthcare into a consumer-grade experience, we drive better health outcomes for children and families while dramatically reducing medical costs for parents and health plans (up to 50% reduction in ED costs).

We are a mission and values driven company. You can learn more about our values HERE. 🫐 💙

Note: Beware of Scammers. Blueberry will NEVER ask you to download software/apps or request sensitive personal information like bank accounts or social security numbers. If you received an email requesting this information it is likely a scam. We are only accepting candidates through our job board.

About Blueberry Balance

Blueberry Balance is a virtual, pediatric-led metabolic health program for adolescents, built by Blueberry Pediatrics. We pair board-certified pediatricians with in-house registered dietitians and exercise specialists to deliver comprehensive weight-management care - including GLP-1 therapy where clinically appropriate - to teens and their families at home.

Adolescent metabolic health is one of the most under-served areas in pediatrics. Most GLP-1 telehealth is built adult-first and gates care at 18, leaving families with elevated-BMI teens to navigate months-long waitlists at hospital-based programs or nothing at all. Balance exists to close that gap with real pediatric expertise and a holistic, family-centered model, never medication in isolation.

The Opportunity

The Registered Dietitian is central to how Balance delivers care. Nutrition is not an add-on to this program — it is half of the treatment. You will review each family's clinical picture, sit with teens and their parents to build a nutrition and care plan that actually fits their life, and stay coordinated with the rest of the care team so every family experiences one coherent plan rather than a set of disconnected touchpoints.

This is a role for a dietitian who wants to work at the front edge of adolescent metabolic care, including alongside GLP-1 therapy, and who sees nutrition counseling as a relationship with a family, not a handout. You will also help shape how this care is delivered as the program grows.

What You’ll Own

  • Intake and clinical review

  • Review intake materials for each new patient, medical history, labs, baseline health evaluation, and prior care, to understand the full clinical picture before the first visit

  • Identify nutrition-relevant risks, comorbidities, and considerations, and flag anything that needs physician attention

Patient and family care

  • Meet with patients and their families via telehealth to assess needs, goals, eating patterns, and readiness for change

  • Design an appropriate, individualized nutrition and care plan for each teen, one that fits the family's life, culture, and resources, and that works in concert with medical treatment including GLP-1 therapy where appropriate

  • Provide ongoing counseling, monitoring, and plan adjustment as the family progresses

Care team coordination

  • Coordinate with physicians, nurse practitioners, health coaches, and other care team members to ensure cohesive, well-managed care for each family

  • Contribute the nutrition perspective to case reviews and care-team communication, so the whole team is working from one plan

Experience You’ll Need

  • Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) credential with the appropriate education and current licensure

  • Experience with, and genuine interest in, working with adolescents with obesity or elevated BMI

  • Experience with, or clear interest in, supporting teens on GLP-1 therapy

  • Licensed to practice in the Balance states — FL, TX, CA, AZ, MI, IL, NY, NJ, PA, OH, UT, AL — or willing to obtain the appropriate licensing and credentialing

  • Availability of 15-20 hours per week, scaling as the program grows

  • Employment classification 1099

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience delivering care on a telemedicine platform

  • Interest in improving care pathways as well as the technology systems that support families, someone who wants to help make the program better, not only work within it

  • Pediatric or adolescent nutrition experience specifically

  • Background in behavioral or family-centered counseling approaches

Time Commitment and Growth Trajectory

This role starts at 15-20 hours per week, and we expect the hours to scale as the Balance patient panel grows. Dietitians who want their engagement to expand alongside the program — and who want a hand in shaping how it delivers care — are a stronger fit than those looking for a fixed, unchanging scope. Hourly rate for this contract position is $60/hr.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Operations to drive critical functions within our Operations department across the urgent care business as well as expansion business lines in this next phase of Blueberry’s growth. Operations is the engine that enables Blueberry to deliver greater access to care and affordability to every child and family. Your north star is to help us further this mission while ensuring sustainability in our business model. That means driving cost and efficiency improvements across key areas of the business while ensuring that we’re delivering an unparalleled care experience to our members, from response times to customer support.

You’ll champion the use of responsible AI to drive automation opportunities and process improvements across our workflows, from end-to-end clinician staffing to licensing & credentialing workflows and medical kit supply chain management. You’ll partner with functional leads to track department KPIs and drive progress toward goals. Additionally, as Blueberry expands into new business lines, you’ll contribute to the clinical operations strategy so we can deliver the same delightful experience we’ve provided to thousands and thousands of our urgent care members over the years. This role reports to the Vice President of Operations.

What You’ll Own

Depending on the candidate, you will be accountable for all or the vast majority of the following domains, and will be expected to be a thought partner on the others.

AI Leverage and Process Improvement

  • Champion responsible AI usage across the department to implement automation opportunities and drive process improvement.

  • Build, test, launch, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows.

  • Scope and prioritize improvement initiatives that will yield the greatest ROI.

  • Develop and recommend tooling that enables the team to 10x their efficiency.

Capacity Planning & Forecasting

  • Own the supply and demand model for all business lines.

  • Partner with our data scientist to refine our forecasting algorithm.

  • Build and maintain the long-term capacity planning model that supports our growth targets.

Clinician Staffing

  • Continuously improve our clinician staffing process across multiple lines of business.

  • Identify opportunities for automation for both the centralized staffing process and the clinician experience.

Licensing & Credentialing

  • Develop automated reporting and oversight infrastructure that ensures clinician licenses and credentials remain active.

  • Support our Operations team in managing our third-party licensing and credentialing vendors as needed.

  • Collaborate with the growth team to forecast future L&C needs and problem-solve potential payer credentialing bottlenecks during client implementations.

Medical Kit Supply Chain

  • Partner with our Supply Chain Manager to identify opportunities to improve kit delivery times.

  • Enhance our inventory management infrastructure along with supply and demand forecasting.

  • Identify savings opportunities while ensuring consistency in device quality.

Customer Support

  • Partner with team leadership to scope and implement automation opportunities that enable us to continue providing personalized customer service at scale.

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to align on improvement initiatives that make it onto the product roadmap.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships across clinical, growth, product, and leadership.

  • Lead cross-functional special initiatives as business needs arise.

  • Contribute to cross-functional workgroups and planning efforts.

  • Turn data and project updates into actionable insights and clear recommendations for leadership.

Experience You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of healthcare operations experience.

  • Process-obsessed and detail-oriented: you see inefficiency and can’t help but fix it.

  • Passion for and demonstrated excellence at solving complex operational problems.

  • Genuinely excited by automation, tooling, and AI.

  • A track record of exceeding financial and operational goals.

  • Strong quantitative instincts: comfortable pulling, analyzing, and reasoning from data, while marrying it with qualitative insights.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, and the ability to be decisive and thrive in a high-growth environment.

  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to build trust and consensus across clinical, growth, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience driving margin or cost improvements.

  • Familiarity with telehealth staffing processes, software, and reporting tools.

  • Understanding of clinician licensing, Medicaid enrollment, and payer credentialing processes with health insurance plans.

  • Experience managing an international supply chain, from sourcing and packaging to 3PL fulfillment and last-mile deliveries.

Expected salary for this role is $120,000 - $133,000 depending on location and experience. The role will have a bonus target in 2027. Equity will also be included.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

The Opportunity

Blueberry is scaling its partnerships with health plans and employers to bring 24/7 pediatric care to families nationwide. We need a hands-on Sales Operations leader who can make our pipeline more reliable, our sales team more productive, and our growth organization more effective.

Reporting to the Head of B2B Growth, you will be an operational partner to sales leadership and work closely with marketing, client success, finance, and other teams. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a broader function as we grow. You will personally configure HubSpot Sales Hub, analyze data, improve processes, and follow through on operational issues.

What You’ll Own

Pipeline Visibility, HubSpot Sales Hub & Accountability

  • Own hands-on HubSpot Sales Hub administration, including workflows, properties, deal stages, automation, dashboards, and troubleshooting.

  • Establish CRM governance, data standards, stage definitions, and reporting consistency; partner with sales leadership to drive adoption and accountability.

  • Own pipeline dashboards and reporting for deal reviews, forecasting, executive updates, and planning. Surface stale deals, unrealistic close dates, missing next steps, conversion trends, and emerging risks before they become surprises.

  • Translate data into recommendations and follow through on corrective actions. Sales leadership retains accountability for deal execution and forecast commitments.

Sales Productivity & Operational Efficiency

  • Build and continuously improve repeatable sales processes from prospecting through contracting and client handoff, including tracking deadlines, commitments, and follow-ups.

  • Identify and implement practical AI and automation use cases for research, reporting, workflow efficiency, and access to sales information; validate outputs and safeguard confidential information.

  • Support account and territory planning, quota tracking, proposals, RFP coordination, and other operational requirements of complex B2B sales cycles.

  • Maintain an organized library of presentations, case studies, RFP responses, playbooks, and onboarding resources; partner with marketing and subject matter experts on content rather than owning all content creation.

Proactive Operational Partnership

  • Act as a proactive partner to the Head of B2B Growth: anticipate issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and drive agreed actions to completion.

  • Coordinate with sales, marketing, client success, and finance to remove bottlenecks and improve the handoff and execution of opportunities.

  • Bring sound judgment, a bias for action, and the confidence to respectfully challenge inconsistent data, weak processes, and unsupported assumptions.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, assess HubSpot Sales Hub and existing workflows, establish a credible baseline for pipeline reporting and data quality, identify priority gaps, and deliver initial improvements. Within six months, leadership should have more dependable visibility into the pipeline, salespeople should spend less time on avoidable administrative work, and key operating issues should be surfaced and resolved proactively. Specific measures and priorities will be agreed with sales leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of relevant Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or closely related experience, with demonstrated hands-on ownership.

  • Advanced HubSpot Sales Hub administration experience, including personally building and maintaining workflows, reports, automations, and CRM structures.

  • Strong pipeline analysis, forecasting support, reporting, and Excel or Google Sheets skills, plus the ability to explain what the numbers mean.

  • A track record of improving processes and driving adoption in fast-changing environments without relying on a large support team.

  • Strong communication, organization, judgment, and the ability to move comfortably between strategic problem-solving and detailed execution.

Preferred: Practical experience implementing AI-enabled workflows or automation, and experience in healthcare, health plans, enterprise SaaS, value-based care, or other complex B2B sales environments.

Location

Full-time, remote position within the United States.

Expected compensation for this role: Base salary between $120,000 - $150,000 depending on location and experience + a performance bonus tied to the success metrics outlined above. The role will also include equity.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  • IT administration. Set up accounts and devices for new hires, administer our SaaS tools, and support teammates with device and account issues.

  • Time to remediate vulnerabilities, by severity

  • Size and age of the open vulnerability backlog

  • EDR and MDM coverage across devices
